implementation: Targeted local implementation of agent-relevant durable execution semantics. No upstream distribution files or runtime-core native artifacts were copied.
mergedFeatures: atomic versioned journals and completed-step replay
durable timers and keyed JSON state
deterministic random values with step sequence restoration
Captain, Crew, approval, and usage boundaries
excluded: unsupported exactly-once claims for arbitrary external side effects
operationalContract: One writer per application profile, enforced by the existing Electron single-instance lock. Crew shares the same store and per-journal write queue. Incomplete external side effects remain at-least-once.
